tools.description: High-magnification electron array resolves silicide stringers and plug cross-sections. The final word on back-end metallization faults.
Four-point sheet-resistance mapping. Spikes reveal organic or metallic contamination films that shift threshold voltage.
Polarized-light reflectometry measures thin-film optical density. Exposes sub-surface STI fill failures invisible to surface scans.
Diamond-tipped stylus maps surface topography line by line. Reveals bow, warp, and flatness deviations against high-NA depth-of-focus limits.
Grazing-incidence X-ray tracks sub-surface layer roughness and density fluctuation. Catches interface traps that steal channel mobility.
